title: Pattern: TRN-131 drops traffic in the evening
description: In Rovaniemi, TRN-131 drops traffic around 21:30 and the radios behind it flap; a line card reboot fixes it. Half of a linked pattern with pattern-trn229-sync-loss-evening: different site, model, team and channel, same evening, and both are linked to TRN-117, which nobody mentions.
subject: TRN-131 traffic drop

incident.summary: TRN-131 dropped traffic, radios behind it flapping

messages.text: Liisa, TRN-131 in Rovaniemi stopped passing traffic at 21:30 and the radios hanging off it are flapping. Can someone look?
On it remotely. Ports are up, counters at zero. Rebooting the line card.
Line card is back and traffic too. Radios stable again.
Thanks! Weird timing, it was fine all day.

items.summary: When TRN-131 stops passing traffic in the evening with its ports UP and counters at zero, rebooting the line card brings traffic back.
items.evidence: seq 3: 'Line card is back and traffic too'
